title: GitHub Issue Auto-Linking in PR Workflow
summary: The dispatch workflow (grill → seed → tasks → export-tasks-gh → build-code → gxpush) creates GitHub issues and PRs as separate, unlinked artifacts. Merging a PR does not auto-close the corresponding GitHub issue. The fix wires three layers: build-code reads export_url from the task JSON, encodes the issue number as a gh-N segment in the branch name, and sets GITHUB_CLOSES env var before calling gxpush. gxpush then appends 'Closes #N' to the PR body — using whichever signal it finds first. This mirrors the existing Linear ticket pattern, where the ticket is encoded in the branch name and extracted by gxpush/pr-desc at PR creation time.
problem_statement: PRs created by the build-code/gxpush workflow do not reference their corresponding GitHub issues. Merging a PR therefore does not auto-close the linked issue. The root cause is that export_url (written back to the task JSON by export-tasks-gh after issue creation) is never read by build-code or gxpush — so the issue number is absent from the branch name and the PR body.
solution: Wire export_url through the build pipeline in two parallel paths (belt and suspenders): (1) build-code encodes the issue number as gh-N in the branch name and (2) sets GITHUB_CLOSES env var. gxpush checks $GITHUB_CLOSES and also applies a regex over the branch name for self-discovery. When either signal is present, gxpush appends 'Closes #N' to the PR body. If export_url is null, both paths are silently skipped.
decisions: Discovery uses both branch name encoding (gh-N segment) AND GITHUB_CLOSES env var — belt and suspenders, same pattern as Linear ticket linking.
Closing keyword injection lives in gxpush: after pr-desc generates the PR body, gxpush appends 'Closes #N'. The pr-desc script is not changed.
Branch name format encodes the GitHub issue number as a gh- prefix segment: feat/t-0023-gh-42-bootstrap-auth.
No schema changes to task-schema.json. export_url is used as-is — for the sapien GitHub repo it is always the GitHub issue URL.
Silent skip when export_url is null — build-code skips branch encoding and GITHUB_CLOSES; gxpush creates the PR without an issue link. No warning emitted.
Logic lives in build-code SKILL.md: read export_url from task JSON, extract issue number, encode gh-N in branch name, set GITHUB_CLOSES env var before calling gxpush.
branching-strategy.md is updated to document the gh-N segment in the branch name format.
gxpush is updated to (a) extract gh-[0-9]+ from the branch name via regex and (b) check $GITHUB_CLOSES env var, then append 'Closes #N' to PR_BODY when either is present.
implementation_decisions: build-code reads task JSON at runtime to obtain export_url — no new schema field or write-back needed.
gxpush regex target: gh-[0-9]+ in the branch name. GITHUB_CLOSES env var is the explicit path; branch regex is the self-discovery fallback.
next_action: Run /to-tasks to break this into implementation tasks for build-code SKILL.md, gxpush, and branching-strategy.md.
